Daikin One Lite  Affordable solution for ductless products.  Small footprint design.  Commissioning and setup can be accomplished with the SkyportCare app.  The end user will be able to control the system remotely through the SkyportHome app.  Additional option for commissioning is through the Daikin One Lite user interface.  Limited features.  Compatible with Amazon Alexa and Google Home.  Open API for integration into most home control systems, such as Crestron® and Control4®. SCAN QR CODE FOR MORE INFORMATION: https://daikincomfort.com/products/cloud-services-apps/cloud-services---apps-homeowner 4 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Daikin One Lite Interface  Pressing or holding down a button or combination of buttons navigates the user through menus to view/adjust settings.  Navigation through menus and adjusting can also be made using tactile gestures on the Daikin One Cloud Services and Daikin One Home applications from your mobile device. 5 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Daikin One Lite Messaging  Daikin One’s messaging updates, confirms, and informs about selections you make during set-up and operation.  There are four types of messages:  Status  Blue-cooling  Red- heating  Alerts  A critical alert is displayed as a message until resolved by the dealer and dismissed by putting the unit in “OFF” mode and then back into an operation mode.  Reminders and Prompts  Learn more/tips (App. Only) 6 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Daikin One Lite Packaging Quick reference cards are packaged with the thermostat to help answer questions during the installation and commissioning.  Scanning the bar code on the bottom left corner will link you to a website related to the title of the card. 7 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Installing Daikin One Lite Thermostat DO NOT install the thermostat where it can be affected by:  Drafts or dead spots behind doors and in corners.  Hot or cold air from ducts or ceiling fans.  Radiant heat from the sun or appliances.  Concealed pipes and chimneys.  Unheated (uncooled) areas such as an outside wall. 11 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Installing Daikin One Lite Thermostat  Mount the thermostat to be  Leveled.  Approximately 5’ from the floor.  On an interior wall using the included screws. Optional Trim Plate SKU #PSPAC-WPM-L 12 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Wiring and Communication Detail  Maximum wire distance between the Daikin One Lite and the translation adaptor should not exceed 125 feet using four conductor 18-gauge field supplied wire.  Seal the hole made for routing the wiring to the thermostat’s terminal subbase.  Check for proper voltage before and after wiring is installed.  0.6VDC between Data 1 and 2  24VAC between R and C  Line voltage 230VAC Note: If wired incorrectly, you will receive an error.  If power wires are reversed the PWR LED will flash green. 1 2 C R Aux to Aux C is a 24V AC Dry contact. Data Line 1 Data Line 2 24 volt common 24 volt power 13 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Aux Heat Wiring  The thermostat's Aux output is a dry contact that closes the connection to turn on the Aux equipment.  A 24VAC+ control signal must be routed through the aux contact of the thermostat. 24VAC+ Line Voltage Field Device Ground* N.O. Com *Daikin One Lite Thermostat Aux Aux C SPST RELAY (Normally Open) *Aux heat is compatible with heat pump systems ONLY Notes: It is recommended to use a minimum of 18-gauge wire. Standard non-stranded thermostat wire is acceptable. Maximum operating length of wire is 125 ft. The terminals are selected in the installer app. 14 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Translation Adaptor Detail S21 wire harness to indoor unit PCB 4 wires removable connector Max 125 ft. field supplied 18AWG 4 conductor, Solid, non shielded Translation adaptor LED Description Max 5-½ ft. Indoor Unit 230VAC 15 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Mounting the Translation Adaptor  Mount using screws.  Never use screws to mount to an indoor unit.  Two channels on the backside of the adaptor allow the S21 and thermostat cables to exit the same side of the adaptor. 16 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Translation Adaptor Location and Considerations Wall mounted indoor unit  If spacing allows, the translation adaptor can be mounted inside the piping chase. Otherwise, it can be mounted on the outside of the indoor unit. Ducted indoor unit  Translation adaptor can be mounted on the side and top of the indoor unit, or above the ceiling using field-supplied double-sided adhesive tape. 17 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning (with Wi-Fi) • Download the SkyportCare app. from your respective app. store. • You will need account to log in • This account will need to be tied to the dealer account registered with SkyportCare • If you do not have an account, click the create account link and follow the process on creating an account before getting started. • Apply profiles enables the technician to modify profile settings through the app. 19 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Connect To The Thermostat Using AP Mode • The user will be prompted to open the mobile device’s Wi-Fi settings and connect to the thermostat Wi-Fi. • Password: 123456789 • If having connectivity issues through the app, turn off Wi-Fi assist (IOS) or Intelligent Wi-Fi (Android) on the mobile device. • NOTE: The SkyportCare app. must remain open while accessing the mobile device’s Wi-Fi settings. • A message will appear at the top of the thermostat’s UI informing the user that their mobile device is connected to the access point. 20 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Connect To Home Wi-Fi • Once connected to the thermostat, the user can connect to a local Wi-Fi network and will no longer need to maintain a 2ft. distance from the controller. • Must be password protected. 21 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Apply System Profile • Once connected to WI-FI, Select the outdoor and indoor model numbers from the menus. • Continue to view thermostat profile options. • Once connected to Wi-Fi, the green icon will be displayed. If access is expired, then the user will see the no access icon . 22 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Apply System Profile (continued) • You can select and or modify any profile to send to the thermostat. • Make edits as needed, then tap “Send to Thermostat” NOTE: Modifying the profile does not affect the default profile 23 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning (without Wi-Fi) • Download the SkyportCare app. from your respective app. store. • You will need an account to log in • This account will need to be tied to the dealer account registered with SkyportCare • If you do not have an account, click the create account link and follow the process on creating an account before getting started. • Apply Profile enables the technician to modify profile settings and send them to the thermostat through the app. Must have Wi-Fi enabled on your mobile device without a network connected 25 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Connect To The Thermostat Using AP Mode • On the thermostat, press and hold the fan button for 5 seconds. • Release the fan button and press the down button to continue. • Approximately 10 seconds to enter AP mode. • AP mode must be active before tapping discover device. • When connecting to the thermostat's access point, the mobile device MUST be within two feet. 26 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Connect To The Thermostat Using AP Mode • The user will be prompted to open the mobile device’s WiFi settings and connect to the thermostat Wi-Fi. • Password: 123456789 • If having connectivity issues through the app, turn off WiFi assist (IOS) or Intelligent Wi-Fi (Android) on the mobile device. NOTE: The SkyportCare app. must remain open while accessing the mobile device’s Wi-Fi settings. • A message will appear at the top of the thermostat’s UI informing the user that their mobile device is connected to the access point. 27 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Apply System Profile • A list of the connected equipment will be populated once equipment settings are detected (may take several minutes). • Verify equipment, then continue to view thermostat profile options. 28 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Apply System Profile (continued) • You can select and or modify any profile to send to the thermostat. • Make edits as needed, then tap “Send to Thermostat” • Without being connected to a network, the user MUST be within two feet of the thermostat. NOTE: Modifying the profile does not affect the saved profile 29 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Account Set-up • Setting up an account is a five-step process. • Downloading the application from your IOS or Android application store. • Creating the account. • Confirming your account. • Adding the thermostats' location. • Connecting the app to the thermostat. Note: A mobile device, the Daikin One Lite connected to Wi-Fi that is wired to an S21 communicating system, and a valid email address is needed to create a mobile account. 31 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Create The Account • Tapping create account at will start the process. • Before agreeing, read the terms and service, privacy statement, and other notices. • Fill in your name, valid email address, and password. 32 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Confirming The Account  You will be prompted to access the email address you provided when creating the account.  A welcome email will appear in your inbox providing a six-digit code.  Entering the six-digit code on your phone app. will allow you to continue. 33 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Adding The Thermostat’s Location • Tap the login button and enter the email and password associated to your mobile account and. • If you have forgotten your password, tap the forgot password link to recover information via email. • Type the address of where the thermostat is located to gather accurate information. • Click Save This Location 34 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Connecting The App. To The Thermostat • Tap the added location and select “add thermostat”. • Once the thermostat has been selected in the app., press and hold the fan button on the thermostat until the words “wireless setup” appears. • Select next on the mobile app. after “wireless setup” appears. 35 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Connecting The App. To The Thermostat (Cont.) • On the thermostat, press the warmer button to reveal the six-digit code. • Select next on the mobile app. after code appears. 36 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.
Connecting The App. To The Thermostat (Cont.) • In the mobile app., enter the code displayed on the thermostat and select “add”. 37 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.
